Intel: Kotlin package header emitted as Module and class name resolved via type_identifier fallback (#111, #112)

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"kotlin\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("package foo.bar\n\nclass Widget {\n    fun greet(): String = \"hi\"\n}\n", config)
    println(result.language)
    println(result.structure)
    println(result.structure.first().kind)
    println(result.metrics.errorCount)
}
```
